title: DOW-UAP-PR061, "Spherical UAP [CALLSIGN] 2021/04/12 vid 0"
what_is_it: A military infrared/full-motion video recording of a spherical unidentified anomalous phenomenon (UAP) captured by a U.S. military platform in the CENTCOM area of responsibility.
interpretation_warnings: No extracted body text available — analysis relies entirely on metadata and the CSV description provided by war.gov.
AARO explicitly notes these materials lack a substantiated chain of custody.
The callsign in the title is redacted, limiting identification of the observing platform.
The video description in the metadata appears truncated, suggesting additional observational detail may be missing.
AARO uses hedged language ('likely derived from'), indicating the provenance assessment is not certain.
The video was uploaded to a classified network three years after the incident, raising questions about intermediary handling.
